svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 07/12 Westwood Village (Common)
svg.desc: The old movie palace tower glows over the village. A premiere some nights, a late show most others. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
